info.name: CalisHealth Integration Test
info.description:
Integration test collection for the CalisHealth platform (SEP490_G9).

It covers every REST endpoint exposed by the Spring Boot backend, grouped by the feature sheets of the "Report-5.2_Integration Test.xlsx" document.

How to use:
1. Set the collection variable "baseUrl" to the address of the running server (default http://localhost:8080).
2. Run "Authentication > Login > Login successfully with valid email and password" and copy the "token" value of the response into the collection variable "memberToken".
3. Repeat the step for an ADMIN and a CONTENT_MANAGER account to fill "adminToken" and "contentToken".
4. Run the whole collection (or a single folder) to execute the integration tests.

Every request carries its own assertions so the run report shows exactly which behaviour each test case establishes.
